description: Move the pickup date/window, delivery date/window, or both, on an existing order. Pickup can only be moved while still in SCHEDULED or PICKUP_ASSIGNED (i.e. driver has not started). Delivery can be moved any time before the delivery driver is en route. Requires order code + email. Pass at least one leg.

email.description: Email used when scheduling. Not needed when the customer has connected their Fold account.

newDeliveryWindow.description: Delivery window label from check_service_zip.deliveryWindows (evening only, e.g. "6:30 PM – 9:30 PM").

name: reschedule_order
title: Reschedule order
